title: ICE with nested impl and closure capture
body:
Found with a [modified fuzz-rustc](https://github.com/jruderman/fuzz-rustc)

### Code

```rust
trait T {}

fn f() -> impl Fn(impl T) {
    let p = ();
    |_| p
}

fn main() {}
```

The ICE occurs with `--edition=2021` but not with `--edition=2018`

### Error output

error[[E0666](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/error_codes/E0666.html)]: nested `impl Trait` is not allowed

error[[E0562](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/error_codes/E0562.html)]: `impl Trait` only allowed in function and inherent method argument and return types, not in `Fn` trait params

thread 'rustc' panicked at [compiler/rustc_mir_build/src/build/expr/as_place.rs:253](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/fdaaaf9f923281ab98b865259aa40fbf93d72c7a/compiler/rustc_mir_build/src/build/expr/as_place.rs#L253):31:
called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value
